title: How can we help?
typeHint: Type or say what you need

question: Question

reexplain: Let's go one step at a time.

checkinTitle: Set up Auralink for your flight
checkinIntro: Choose how you would like to talk with the cabin crew. Your seat screen will open this way.

readDesc: The phone reads questions and replies out loud

suggestTitle: I'm not fully sure, here's what I understood
suggestOrSend: Or send this message to crew (translated, not reviewed)
convListening: Listening… just talk, no need to tap
offlineBody: Show this screen to a flight attendant. Tap a picture below — it will send as soon as the connection returns.
arrivalIntro: Gate, baggage and your connection, in your own language.
lostFoundIntro: Left something on board? Describe it and your seat — crew will check before the cabin is cleaned.
lostFoundPlaceholder: e.g. a grey water bottle in the seat pocket
feedbackIntro: Tell us what went well or what we could improve. This never shows your name.
